description.value: Canco is a Canadian independent chain of gas stations with attached convenience stores, operating under the 'One Stop by Canco' retail brand and owned by PR Petroleum Ltd., which runs over 160 locations coast to coast. This Vernon location on Okanagan Landing Road combines fuel sales with in-store convenience shopping and is part of the Canco Cash loyalty program. Touring cyclists will find it a practical roadside stop for snacks and supplies along the Okanagan Landing corridor.
